column1: # SpiritVale's complete StatType catalog, 219 entries, read from the community
# client datamine at spiritvalers.com/mechanics in July 2026.
# This is the game's entire stat vocabulary: every value an item, skill, buff or
# passive is allowed to move. `flat` adds a number, `percent` a multiplier.
# Worth noticing before reading the rows:
#   - The first six are the six attributes, ids 0 to 5, then AllStats at 6.
#   - Ids 92 to 175 are almost entirely SUMMON stats. A summoner class needs a
#     parallel copy of most of the sheet.
#   - Ids 197 to 218 are all SKILL-modifier stats (Skill Pull, Skill Instances,
#     Skill Replace, Skill Apply Status). Gear here can rewrite what a skill
#     does, not just how hard it hits.
#   - Ids 28 to 38 are the DENIAL flags (No Action, No Move, Cannot Attack,
#     No Cast, No Flee, No Regen). Statuses are expressed as stats.
